routeProfiles.name: Sicily in June
routeProfiles.rationale: Sicily is highly fire-prone and the July 2026 island-wide emergency confirms that the consequence can be severe. Timing matters: the regional 2023 analysis found no critical fire conditions from early summer through mid-July before a sharp late-July surge. June is meaningfully safer than July, but not low-risk.

value.aggregation: The trip inherits the lowest safety score among its route profiles so one exposed base cannot be hidden by a low-risk base.
value.monitoring: Recheck official daily fire-danger maps and active incidents 14 days, 72 hours, and each morning before a rural drive or hike. A live red/extreme warning overrides this climatology.

sourceLocators.sicily-fire-history-2023: Regional report pp. 14–17: no critical June/early-July phase; July 24 surge; 74,341 hectares burned in Sicily in 2023
